subject: Medicore dedicated activation — validation windows & cutover coordination
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@medicore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Medicore dedicated activation — validation windows & cutover coordination

Hi Jill,

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. As discussed, we're lining up the last hosted->dedicated swap and want to confirm a practical validation and cutover timeline so procurement and your infra team can plan. High-level asks: 

- One 2-hour throughput validation run (our load harness) against the dedicated slice with your representative traffic sample.
- One 30–60 minute smoke cutover rehearsal (read-only traffic) a week before the final swap.
- Final swap weekend window (2–4 hours) with fallbacks (hosted traffic reroute).

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Validation run: Tue Oct 13, 09:00–11:00
- Smoke rehearsal: Tue Oct 20, 10:00–11:00
- Production swap: Sat Oct 24, 02:00–05:00

Attached a draft SOW (MDCR-SOW-v3.pdf) and a short checklist for the validation run. Can you confirm that Oct 13 works for your infra team and whether procurement needs any additional artifacts for the PO?

If those dates are tight, we have a backup: validation run week of Oct 18 and swap weekend Nov 7.

CC'ing Karthik and Ben to confirm the load profile and preflight requirements; Monica from onboarding to align runtime ops and runbook.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: MDCR-SOW-v3.pdf (draft SOW, 5 pages)
From: Jill Harper <jill.harper@medicore.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicore.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Medicore dedicated activation — validation windows & cutover coordination

Priyom,

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick updates from our side: procurement is ready to move once we have the finalized SOW and a confirmed swap date + acceptance criteria. Our infra lead (Samir) is OOO next week until Oct 11, so Oct 13 is tight. 

We can commit to the validation run on Tue Oct 20, 09:00–11:00 ET, and do the smoke rehearsal on Tue Oct 27 10:00–11:00 ET. For the production swap, Oct 31 weekend would be preferable for our change freeze calendar — Sat Oct 31, 02:00–05:00 ET. If Redwood needs the earlier window, we can try to prioritize but will need a standing on-call from your side.

Procurement attached a placeholder PO (PO_MEDICORE_1026.pdf). We're also asking security for a short list of audit logs we'll need post-cutover for a brief compliance attestation; I'll share that next week.

Thanks,
Jill
VP Product, Medicore Health

Attachment: PO_MEDICORE_1026.pdf (purchase placeholder)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 08:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Medicore dedicated activation — validation windows & cutover coordination

Looping in some specifics for the validation run (note: internal technical thread).

Karthik — proposed run profile to match Medicore production traffic: 60k tokens/min sustained for 60–90s bursts; 8 concurrent client flows with expected 95th latency SLA 220ms. We'll need these items from Medicore before the run:
- Representative request sample (anonymized) and a small set of failure-case prompts (for quality gates)
- VPN tunnel + test credentials in advance (we'll provide an IP allowlist)
- A target model bundle (you listed r-instruct-13b-fp16 in the SOW; confirm quantization/variant)

I've attached the harness output from a recent internal dry-run against a similar slice (medicore-throughput-run-20261004.csv) so we can align acceptance thresholds — note the spike behavior at 75s.

Priyom — if Medicore switches the swap to Oct 31, we should schedule a short pre-cutover call the week prior to review rollback runbook and traffic steering play. Monica, can you draft the on-call rota for that weekend (include DevOps, EngOps, and a Redwood product lead)?

- Ben

Attachment: medicore-throughput-run-20261004.csv (sanitized harness results)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Harper <jill.harper@medicore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@medicore.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Medicore dedicated activation — validation windows & cutover coordination

Hi Jill — thanks for the quick reply and for the PO stub. Oct 20 for the validation run and Oct 27 for smoke rehearsal look good; we can aim for production swap weekend Oct 31, 02:00–05:00 ET. We'll treat Oct 31 as the target with Nov 7 as fallback.

Actions agreed: 
- Redwood to finalize SOW (attached earlier) and send DocuSign link by EOD Tue Oct 6.
- Medicore to provide anonymized request sample + failure-case prompts by Wed Oct 14.
- Redwood to provision VPN test endpoint and provide creds by Fri Oct 16.
- Validation run: Tue Oct 20, 09:00–11:00 ET (Redwood will run load harness; Medicore to observe and provide real-time feedback).
- Smoke rehearsal: Tue Oct 27, 10:00–11:00 ET (read-only traffic).
- Pre-cutover call: Thu Oct 29, 16:00 ET — review rollback and traffic steering playbook.
- Production swap: Sat Oct 31, 02:00–05:00 ET (engineer on-call list provided by Monica).

Confirmed next steps on our side: I'll drop the DocuSign link into HubSpot and route to procurement. Karthik, Ben — please join the pre-cutover and be prepared for a 30-min dry failover test during the rehearsal. Monica — can you circulate the on-call rota by Oct 8?

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth swap.

Best,

Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/MDCR-2026-017), DocuSign (https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/XYZ-MDCR-2026-017)
